svg.text: Archimedes-screw lift raises objects to a scan chamber, then a servo flap tree drops them into 4 bins
ISOMETRIC ENGINEERING VIEW · units ≈ cm · grid = 10 cm · orange arrows = object flow · red dashed = sensor beam · translucent = acrylic
→ Operator drops object here; gravity feeds the auger
→ Helix carries objects up the tube
→ Slides object into the inspection chamber
→ Object waits on the gate while scanned
→ Releases the object after the decision
→ Set flap A, B1, B2 per class
→ Keep objects in the Plinko channel
→ One per class, at the base
→ Speed control of the lift motor
Zero-contact sorting: objects are lifted by an Archimedes screw and then
sorted purely by gravity through a servo-flap binary tree (2 flaps = 4 bins, 3
flaps = 8). Tall, transparent and very photogenic.
IR gate at the ramp starts the lift motor; screw carries the
Object rests on the gate while camera + RGB sensor classify it
Class → 2-bit code: flap A picks left/right half, flap B1/B2
